description: Data for: Location Selection of Hybrid Wind/ MSW Biomass Power Plant by Z-number fuzzy DEA Considering Waste Collection Problem (Case study: Iran) is published by Mendeley. The dataset supports fuzzy multi-criteria selection of hybrid wind and municipal-waste power-plant locations. Its stated coverage is Iran; 31 decision-making units in the study. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Expert or fuzzy factors should not be treated as direct physical measurements. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
